independent_oracle.usage: Independent test oracle only. Signed EAC base -128 is canonicalized to -127 before calling upstream, as required by GLES3 Appendix C; upstream otherwise rejects it.

block_v1.cause_and_correction: ETC color sum overflowed nine signed bits before saturation; carry is retained.

color_diagnostic_v2.cause_and_correction: RGB individual-mode blue271 was truncated before clamp; expected255 observed0.

image_v4.cause_and_correction: Reconstruction fixture packed repeated EAC selectors in host order; compressed byte order fixes it. Production decode was correct.

controls_v6.cause_and_correction: Cancellation scan ended at28 cycles before retirement; expanded40 offsets includes28 cancelled and12 held outcomes.

limits: All 64 GLES3.0 image storage encodings are admitted for native integer-coordinate component fetch, including10 ETC2/EAC formats; full GLES/H0-H8 closure remains open.
General filtering/LOD, swizzle, depth comparison, decoded-block caching, representative Mobile throughput, compiler/driver adoption and whole-GPU synthesis remain open.
Image decoder is serialized: uncompressed12 cycles, compressed18 cycles; composed address latency grows4 to5 cycles while preserving one address/cycle.
No new ISA encodings, descriptor layouts or attachment formats are introduced. PPA is synthesis only.
